jobs.title: Deployment Strategist (Payors)
jobs.description:
Role Mission

As Deployment Strategist for Payors
at Hippocratic AI
, you will lead customer deployments that translate AI into measurable operational outcomes for health plans and payor organizations. You will work closely with customers to plan implementations, coordinate cross functional teams, drive adoption, and ensure each deployment delivers value in complex administrative, care management, and member facing workflows.

This role exists because successful deployment in payor environments requires more than strong execution alone. It requires someone who understands payor operations, can navigate complex stakeholder groups, can connect product capabilities to business and clinical priorities, and can guide organizations through implementation and change. You will serve as both a strategic partner and an execution lead, helping customers move from initial planning through launch and long term impact.

What You Will Accomplish

Own your first major outcome:
By day 90
, you will have supported or led your first major payor deployment through a successful implementation milestone, built strong working relationships with key customer stakeholders, identified operational risks and dependencies early, and contributed to deployment playbooks that improve consistency and speed across future implementations.

Drive lasting impact:
At 12 months
, you will have led multiple payor deployments across a range of customer environments and use cases, become a trusted partner to customer and internal teams, helped standardize implementation processes and operating rhythms, and directly contributed to faster time to value, stronger adoption, and more scalable delivery across the payor segment.

The Team

You’ll work alongside implementation managers, engineers, product managers, customer success partners, and clinical experts
, partnering closely with customers while staying deeply connected to internal cross functional teams. You’ll operate with significant ownership, balancing strategic customer guidance with detailed execution. This is a team that values customer obsession, operational rigor, clarity, and practical problem solving
in real healthcare environments.

What You'll Do

Lead deployment planning and execution for payor customers, ensuring clear timelines, ownership, milestones, and successful implementation outcomes
Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business priorities, operational workflows, compliance considerations, and implementation constraints, then translate them into actionable deployment plans
Coordinate across deployment, product, engineering, and customer facing teams to keep implementations aligned and moving forward
Drive implementation readiness, including stakeholder alignment, rollout sequencing, training plans, risk tracking, and launch preparation
Identify blockers early and proactively resolve issues that could affect go live timelines, member experience, internal operations, or customer outcomes
Help customers navigate rollout and adoption by setting expectations, building trust, and guiding them through organizational change
Capture learnings from deployments and turn them into repeatable playbooks, templates, and best practices that improve future implementations
Use deployment insights to inform internal product and process improvements, helping the organization deliver more effectively at scale

Location Requirement

This is a United States-based
role open to candidates across multiple markets. We welcome applications from candidates located throughout the U.S. Specific placement, travel expectations, and regional alignment will be determined during the hiring process based on customer proximity, deployment portfolio needs, and your location. You should expect regular travel, typically 25 to 40% depending on deployment schedule
, for on site implementation support, customer meetings, training, and go live activities.

Required Qualifications

Experience in deployment, implementation, customer success, strategic operations, consulting, or a related customer facing role, ideally with enterprise or healthcare customers
Strong understanding of payor-side healthcare workflows, operations, and organizational dynamics, either through direct experience in health plans or through customer facing implementation work in payor environments
Proven ability to manage complex customer engagements with multiple stakeholders across operations, clinical programs, IT, compliance, and executive functions
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between customer goals, operational realities, and internal execution plans
Strong project leadership and problem solving skills, especially in fast moving environments where priorities evolve and ambiguity is common
Track record of driving execution across cross functional teams and maintaining momentum through complex implementations
Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational follow through, ensuring plans convert into measurable outcomes
required BA/BS degree

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience working with health plans, managed care organizations, payors, or adjacent healthcare organizations
Familiarity with payor implementation challenges such as care management workflows, utilization management, member engagement, operational change management, and cross functional coordination
Experience building or improving repeatable deployment processes, playbooks, and delivery frameworks across multiple customer environments
Comfort serving as a trusted advisor to customers while also handling detailed execution work
Experience with AI, digital health, member operations tools, care navigation, or other technology deployments in healthcare settings
Familiarity with healthcare compliance and operational requirements relevant to payor environments, including HIPAA and related data handling considerations

Why This Role

This role is an opportunity to help define how breakthrough AI becomes real, trusted, and effective in payor organizations. You will work at the intersection of customer partnership, operational execution, and healthcare transformation, helping ensure deployments succeed not just technically, but in the day to day workflows that shape member, clinical, and operational outcomes.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.
We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future.
Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.
We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.
Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @
hippocraticai.com
email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Dewatering Project Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction & Key Role Objectives

WJ Groundwater is the leading construction dewatering and groundwater specialist in the UK with operations in Canada, the Middle East, Poland & the Philippines. We have specialized plant and equipment that allows us to install custom dewatering systems in various environments including from within tunnels and shafts and from the surface.

The primary function of this position is to ensure that dewatering system performance meets client expectations and that projects are executed on time and within budget. This role will act as the key liaison between the design and installation teams, leading dewatering operations and serving as the main contact for clients.

We are dedicated to fostering the growth and development of our employees. We provide extensive internal and external training programs, continuous learning opportunities, and clear career advancement paths to help our team members achieve their full potential. By promoting a supportive and dynamic environment, we ensure our employees thrive and contribute to our company's ongoing success and innovation.

Reports to Dewatering Division Manager

Key Areas of Responsibility

Deliver WJ’s contractual obligations by defining the project program to meet targets and achieve top-tier industry benchmarks for quality, financials, and overall project delivery.
Supervise and plan site activities and coordinate with clients, site staff, supervisors, subcontractors and suppliers to resolve issues and ensure project progress.
Ensure project profitability by controlling costs through BOQ analysis and effective planning of expenditures and workforce requirements.
Monitor dewatering performance, oversee material selection and system modifications, and suggest optimizations based on project goals and site conditions.
Prepare Method Statements with CAD drawings, cross sections and work procedures.
Prepare, issue, and negotiate monthly payment applications, and assist in the AR process.
Contribute to the development and application of dewatering system methodologies and techniques to ensure high-quality technical delivery and maintain industry expertise.
Perform project management responsibilities, including managing change orders and commercial details, and preparing engineering and financial status reports for clients.
Maintain high-quality documentation of WJ’s contractual activities including the collection, collation and presentation of data.
Undertake business development activities, including site visits, client discussions, and the preparation of tenders and quotations for new contracts.
Ensure personal health and safety, as well as that of reporting staff, by preparing Risk Assessments, briefing, and auditing site staff to enforce safe working practices.

The above is not exhaustive and you will be expected to undertake any other duties that may reasonably fall within the level of responsibility and competence.

Qualifications & Experience

A motivated and hardworking individual with good written and communication skills is essential
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Geotechnical, Environmental) or a related field
Over 5 years of project management and/or construction experience in dewatering, groundwater management, or related infrastructure, with skills in budgeting, scheduling, and resource allocation
An understanding of water management, hydrogeology, engineering geology, or civil engineering, including water well drilling, development and rehabilitation
Proven ability in supervising dewatering operations across various ground and groundwater conditions
Experience in contract administration, client relations, and construction field supervision, including oversight of geotechnical activities
Familiarity with construction industry contracts and commercial issues is preferred
Advanced IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and Autodesk Suite
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills, capable of managing workloads and multiple high-value projects under tight deadlines
Strong leadership and team management skills with proven ability to plan, organize, and schedule workloads for both self and others
Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to read and modify technical drawings and effectively communicate complex ideas to multidisciplinary teams
Resourcefulness, initiative, and the ability to work independently
A valid driver’s licence and access to a vehicle is required for travel between project sites

Working Conditions

This role is primarily based at our head office in Toronto but requires site visits for client meetings, site inspections, inductions, and project briefings, with occasional full-day work on client worksites. The role involves installing dewatering systems in various environments, including both outdoor and indoor settings, such as tunnels, adits, and shafts, which are classified as low to medium risk confined spaces. Comfort with working in all weather conditions, on heavy industrial construction sites, and within confined spaces is essential.

Standard working hours are 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional flexibility needed. Occasional flexibility in working hours may be required.

Accessibility & Accommodation

WJ Groundwater is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including persons with disabilities. Accommodation is available upon request throughout the recruitment and selection process.

This is an existing position and all applications are reviewed by our hiring team. AI is not used in the screening or selection process.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role

Reporting to the Director, Digital Delivery Portfolio, the Program Manager plays a key role in overseeing and coordinating the program's various mandates, facilitating communication and collaboration among teams. The Program Manager is responsible for managing risks and dependencies at the program level, ensuring accountability and optimizing processes. They will work closely with several members of management and more closely with the managers of their program (product, technology, design) to ensure that program objectives are achieved and that projects are aligned with the organization’s strategic priorities.

Duties and responsibilities:

Participate in the program’s objective and expected results planning process jointly with the Senior Management, and the managers of their program (product, technology, design).
Ensure that the program is aligned with Digital Products & Innovation and Radio-Canada strategic directions, and that projects are prioritized accordingly.
Participate in the program’s annual budgeting process (business plan).
Ensure compliance with the program’s labour budget.
Be involved in early conversations before project start-up, such as: strategic vision, initiation/design phase, technical analysis, etc.
Facilitate assessment of resourcing needs with the program managers (product, technology, design), Project Managers or product leads for the entire program.
Optimize resource utilization within the program and between programs.
Gather all roadmaps and timelines from the program’s teams in order to gain visibility into current and upcoming workstreams.
Manage and share changes in priorities.
Manage dependencies, risks and issues at the program level:
Consolidate all risks and issues as well as their mitigation and contingency plans in a living document that is always accessible to teams and management.
Consolidate and share program dependencies identified by team members, external teams, other program managers or stakeholders, along with their dependency management plan, in a living document that is always accessible to teams and management.
If needed, identify issues requiring stakeholder management and specify who is responsible for informing and consulting the relevant stakeholders.
Conduct a planning session with relevant parties to assess impacts and identify mitigation and contingency actions if this has not already been done.
Assign responsibility for monitoring and resolving each issue or plan within the agreed time frame.
Clearly communicate the entire plan, ensuring that all team members understand their roles and responsibilities.

Ensure accountability to the management:
Review monthly progress reports on the various program mandates.
Supported by the managers within the program, the program manager is responsible for reviewing and challenging the progress, risk and issue reports provided by the Project Managers.
Ensure that Project Managers develop and implement the action plan to move projects from yellow status to green status.
Escalate red-status projects to Senior Management and help resolve issues with the Project Managers and Product Owners concerned.
Produce the monthly program report and present it to management.
Responsible for tracking and measuring the established operational success indicators.

Manage the lessons learned process. Ensure that team retrospectives take place, gather relevant key learnings and share them within the program as well as with the Digital Products & Innovation program managers’ group and the Director of the Digital Delivery Portfolio.
Facilitate the implementation of new project management tools and practices (including performance indicators) and ensure change management.
Recruit and ensure the integration of new Project Managers within the program.
Manage and develop the talent of the program's Project Managers; support the development of their objectives and lead the annual evaluation exercise.
As members of the program management team, the Program Manager, and the managers of the product, design, and technology directorates are jointly and collectively responsible for the team’s success. They support each other, share information openly and respect each other’s areas of responsibility.

Required Skills:

Knowledge and experience:

Demonstrated past success as a leader in a similar digital development experience in a large company.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in project management, communication, business administration or other relevant field.
10 years’ project management experience.
Three to five years’ experience in program management or in a role that involved the strategic coordination of multiple projects or products.
Five to ten years’ experience in a digital environment.
Three to five years’ experience as a manager (recruitment, performance management).
Proficiency in French and English (oral and written).
Proficiency with the Google suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Gemini).
Experience in artificial intelligence tool integration.
Knowledge of Lean Management principles, an asset.
Very good knowledge of Jira, Tempo and Confluence.

Soft skills:

Demonstrates confidence, transparency and integrity.
Proactive, resourceful.
Strong, inclusive leader with the ability to bring people together.
Ability to rally people with diverging interests.
Communicates clearly, often.
Collaborative spirit.
Adaptability and flexibility.

Expertise:

Decisive mindset, with the ability to drive and make decisions.
Conflict resolution skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities and multitask.
Ability to face uncertain and ambiguous situations.
Knows how to adapt their communication style based on their interlocutors.
Intervenes impartially and tactfully to diagnose and resolve conflicts, maintaining a healthy and productive team dynamic.
Acts as a change leader, capable of mobilizing teams, communicating the vision, and managing buy-in during the implementation of new practices.

Acts as a mentor and coach for the Project Managers to develop their skills in both expertise (project management) and soft skills.

jobs.title: Program Manager II, Amazon Customs and Trade, Amazon Customs and Trade
jobs.description:
Description

Are you excited by the idea of building financial systems that power global trade? As Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT) expands its global reach and technology product portfolio, it needs billing infrastructure that can keep pace with onboarding new customers across markets. We are looking for a Program Manager to own end-to-end financial automation and compliance program delivery across our customs finance operations. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Tax, Accounting, Compliance, and Engineering, translating upstream product decisions into correctly configured, operationally ready financial systems that enable accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) payment flows with vendors, ports of entry, and government entities worldwide.

You will manage a cross-functional program independently, own all program communication, and drive timely decisions across partner teams. The configuration work you deliver is the on/off switch for Amazon's ability to bill, collect revenue, make vendor payments, and meet financial obligations to government and legal entities. A misconfigured charge code means invoices do not generate, disbursements do not clear, and government fees go unremitted. If you thrive in high-stakes, detail-oriented environments where your work has immediate and measurable financial impact, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Lead the financial readiness lifecycle from intake through post-launch stabilization, ensuring no incomplete or non-compliant work reaches engineering and coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate system behavior before launch.
Drive AP and AR automation execution across multiple regions in partnership with Accounting, Tax, and billing engine teams, and set up performance indicators where none exist.
Manage onboarding of new trading partners and broker billing model migrations, including net-new legal entity standup, working with Finance, Compliance, and Engineering stakeholders to meet regulatory and financial obligations.
Own the charge code, company code, and Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) configuration pipeline across ACT finance systems by sequencing intake, managing prioritization, and driving requests to completion.

You join recurring syncs with Engineering, Finance, Tax, and Accounting teams to align on open work-streams and unblock dependencies. As ACT expands its global footprint, you will gain deep expertise in how financial automation is applied to cross-border trade, growing your skills at the convergence of finance, compliance, and technology. Description

The Bespoke Solutions Teams is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to own contractor operations, vendor management, and lab/manufacturing coordination for a high-assurance hardware program within AWS Infrastructure Services — the team building security and encryption devices for government customers.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. You will consolidate contractor hiring and management, own vendor and license agreements, and serve as the operational backbone that lets our senior engineers stay focused on delivery. You will be the connective tissue across engineering, supply chain, security, and external manufacturing partners — removing friction and reducing key-person dependencies on a fast-moving classified program.

You will own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, manage vendor and license agreements, coordinate contract manufacturing (including onboarding a new contract manufacturer), and serve as the lab owner. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Contractor & Resource Management

Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Vendor, License & Lab Ownership

Manage vendor and license agreements
Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
Serve as the lab owner

Contract Manufacturing

Own contract manufacturing for the program, including onboarding a new contract manufacturer
Handle associated administrative tasks including purchasing coordination.
Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to keep prototype and production builds on schedule

Cross-Organization Coordination

Partner with engineering, systems engineering, security, and leadership to keep operational execution tight
Serve as primary operational liaison for contractor, vendor, and manufacturing matters
Provide program status, risk, and resourcing visibility to engineering leads and program leadership

A day in the life

You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. The team executes against a multi-year roadmap spanning hardware, firmware, programmable logic, and systems engineering — with a growing contractor base and expanding manufacturing footprint. This Program Manager role is the operational anchor that keeps contractor, vendor, and manufacturing execution running smoothly as the program scales from prototype into production.

About The Team

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

7+ years of program or project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Experience managing vendor and license agreements and purchasing/procurement coordination
Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
Experience in a hardware, FPGA, or manufacturing program environment

Coördinatie & Governance

jobs.title: Senior Intelligence Analyst, Amazon Cyber Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Cyber Threat Intelligence (ACTI) organization is responsible for investigating, analyzing, and defending against sophisticated cyber threats targeting Amazon's global businesses and customers. ACTI combines technical expertise, strategic analysis, and advanced tooling to identify emerging threats, track adversary activities, and provide actionable intelligence across Amazon's security ecosystem.

As a Senior Intelligence Analyst within ACTI, you will architect and lead the creation of professional finished intelligence products that leverage ACTI's unique technical insights as well as other sources. You will utilize your extensive cyber threat intelligence knowledge to extract novel insights, trends, and themes from the output of ACTI technical processes and engineers. You will present your findings across a broad array of internal stakeholders, including Amazon Security executives and the leadership of ACTI and other security teams. Your technical and written leadership will drive ACTI's products and reporting program forward as you develop new product lines, find better ways to get actionable intelligence to internal customers, and gather customer feedback to inform future reporting.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities

Conduct in-depth research and analysis of potential cyber threats to Amazon, AWS, subsidiaries, and their customers
Collect, manipulate, and analyze data from multiple sources and assess this information to identify security threats and develop recommendations and reporting accordingly
Prepare written reports and presentations based on your research, collection, and analysis of intelligence data
Prepare and present oral and written reports on the conclusions and recommendations drawn from your research
Lead and participate in collaborative working groups and other initiatives

A day in the life

As a Senior Intelligence Analyst on ACTI, your day might start by reviewing overnight threat actor activity flagged by our automated triage systems, then pivoting into drafting a finished intelligence assessment on an emerging campaign targeting AWS customers. Mid-morning you collaborate with partner intelligence teams on products. After lunch you collaborate with engineers to refine an AI-powered analytical workflow, then spend the afternoon developing a new product line based on customer feedback. You close the day by mentoring other analysts on analytic tradecraft and reviewing their draft report before publication. No two days look the same, but every day produces intelligence that protects millions of customers.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills

Experience working in collaborative environments, while demonstrating strong verbal communication and presentation skills. Experience producing professional, well-written documentation

Company

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Program manager to lead our Catalog listing audit efforts across the business. This role is a high-impact role that contributes directly to improving the overall quality of the catalog, which has a direct impact on our customers, both sellers, and buyers. This role is also expected to be a people leader, managing a team of auditors and ensuring the quality, trustworthiness, and safety of our catalog listings.
Working in a dynamic environment, you will be responsible for automating dashboards, monitoring key success metrics, managing WBR reports, identifying problem areas and business challenges and collaboratively shaping solutions with Coupang’s catalog product and engineering teams to help optimize on the platform. The successful candidate has a passion for extracting actionable insights from data. The candidate needs to innovate, and quickly become a subject matter expert to assess business performance across different catalog llsting categories. The candidate should have significant experience working with automation, analyzing data, identifying trends, extracting conclusions, and presenting findings in a simple and clear manner using data across various data marts, and align focus on Coupang’s strategic needs. The candidate should enjoy problem solving and is proficient in VBA and other automation tools.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with various teams across the business to address concerns, provide feedback, and ensure that the necessary changes are implemented effectively
Defect Identification: Understanding drivers, impacts, and key influences of defects in our Catalog
Defect Reporting : Automate defect reporting for weekly business metrics, identify areas of opportunity to automate and scale ad-hoc analysis
Measurement : Partnering with Coupang’s Catalog product and engineering team to create key performance indicators and new methodologies for measurement
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities and recommend strategies to enhance the audit process and overall listing quality, always aiming for excellence

Qualifications

Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
Knowledge of SQL and Excel at an advanced level
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum of 8 years experience in business analytics + program management preferably w/ an eCommerce platform
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal bi-lingual (english + korean) candidates preferred
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively
Proficiency with data analysis tools and software
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or any related quantitative field is preferred

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

Graduate Program Overview

The CRB Graduate Development Program (GDP) is a non-rotational 17-month program that provides the opportunity to develop a broad knowledge base, varied skills, and diverse network. This program is designed to set you up with a holistic view of CRB with hands-on experience, insight, and opportunities to make an impact and shape your own career.

GDP participants will be immersed in a 1-week orientation followed by a robust onboarding training learning about various functions within CRB. Our program is designed to provide graduates with a well-rounded understanding of the industry while having the opportunity to deep dive within their respective business area.

R&A Enterprise Risk Consulting Overview

Colleagues working in Risk & Analytics’ Enterprise Risk Consulting (ERC) team provide our clients with a smarter way to analyze risk, using quantification, structured approaches, risk analytics tools and subject matter expertise to improve client outcomes. With our expertise and tailored solutions, we improve complex enterprise risk management by identifying, quantifying and mitigating unpredictable, interconnected risks.

We currently work with some of the world’s largest and complex organizations to assess and manage their strategic risks. We also work with smaller organizations early in their ERM journeys. We work across many industries including Food & Beverage, Professional Services, Transportation / Logistics, Energy, Construction, Manufacturing and others. Work within ERC is predominantly project-based, and you will often be involved in multiple projects simultaneously. Our work is often collaborative, providing exposure to a range of teams within the division.

Responsibilities:

As an Analyst within Risk & Analytics' Enterprise Risk Consulting (ERC) team, you will support the delivery of client projects that help organizations identify, assess, quantify, and manage enterprise risks while strengthening organizational resilience.

You will work alongside consultants, data scientists, actuaries, catastrophe modelers, business continuity specialists, and industry experts to deliver solutions for some of the world's largest organizations.

Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) assessments and maturity reviews
Enterprise-wide risk identification, prioritization, and risk register development

Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and operational resilience programs

You will also contribute to the development of new consulting methodologies, tools, and thought leadership. Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders

Hands-on experience with innovative risk analytics and AI-enabled solutions
A strong foundation for a career in enterprise risk management, business continuity, resilience, and risk consulting

Date of Graduation between May 2026 – May 2027

jobs.title: FINANCE DATA ANALYST
jobs.description:
About

Sekoia.io repense la cybersécurité pour la rendre encore plus pertinente
, efficace
et accessible
. L'un des principaux défis que nous relevons est d'analyser et de comprendre en permanence les menaces émergentes
afin de définir des stratégies appropriées et d'avoir la capacité de les exécuter à grande échelle. En combinant la technologie
et une équipe pluridisciplinaire
de passionnés de Threat Intelligence, Sekoia.io a un fort impact sur la cybersécurité
avec une approche qui brise les silos
, qu'ils soient technologiques, organisationnels ou culturels.

Job Description

Sekoia
is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence. Following a €26M Series B in 2025, we are scaling the company and preparing for the next stages of our development.

As Finance Data Analyst
, you will turn fragmented financial and corporate data into reliable information for decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Finance
and working closely with Data Engineering
, you will act as the bridge between Finance and technical teams.

You will map data sources
, clarify definitions, investigate discrepancies, and structure the datasets and reporting needed for financial and corporate steering. You will work hands-on with the available data without owning the data lake or every integration end-to-end. Your role will be to challenge data quality and assumptions
, document what is missing, and help Finance and leadership rely on consistent and actionable information.

In this evolving environment, you will bring structure while keeping a practical focus on delivering useful analysis, reporting, and automation.

Systems In Scope

Your scope will cover data from the main systems used for financial, commercial, operational, and corporate steering:

Data: Metabase (you will be the owner of the tool)
Finance and planning: Pennylane, Agicap, Pigment (you will be the owner of the data in the tool), and Excel
Revenue and CRM: HubSpot and Younium
People and expenses: Lucca, SILAE, Navan, and TeamTailor (ATS - recruitment tool)
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Azure, and OVH billing data

You will work with Data Engineering and the relevant system owners to connect, transform, document, reconcile, and improve the accessibility of this data.

Your Missions

Map and structure Finance data
Map the systems, data sources, owners, definitions, and flows used for financial and corporate steering.
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplications, and reconciliation issues between sources.
Define the data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.
Clarify the definitions and calculation rules for key metrics such as revenue, ARR, NRR, headcount, payroll cost, COGS, cash, and spend.
Maintain a prioritised backlog of data needs and improvement opportunities with Finance and Data Engineering.
Turn data into reliable analysis
Explore and model data from the data lake and connected business systems.
Build consistent, documented, and reusable Finance and corporate datasets.
Reconcile data across accounting, billing, RevOps, HR, payroll, cash management, and spend-management systems.
Produce recurring analyses and reporting to support Finance and leadership decision-making.
Build dashboards and self-service views when the underlying data is sufficiently reliable.
Support budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS metrics analysis.
Improve data quality and automate reporting
Work with Data Engineering and system owners to complete missing data sources, transformations, and quality checks.
Automate recurring analyses, reconciliations, and reporting where this creates clear value.
Contribute to data quality monitoring, documentation, and governance for Finance-related data.
Document data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, and known limitations.
Prepare reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI use cases.
Handle HR, payroll, and other sensitive data with a high level of confidentiality and rigour.

You will work closely with the Head of Finance
, Data Engineering
, the RevOps Manager
, the FinOps Manager
, and other data owners across the company to align definitions, clarify responsibilities, and make Finance data more reliable and accessible.

📍 The position is ideally based in Paris, but can also be based in Rennes, or fully remote from Europe. Professional trips paid for by the company might be required.

Your Profile

🤩 We are excited to meet you if :

You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, Finance analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related role.
You have strong analytical skills and are able to investigate data across several systems to identify the reasons behind discrepancies.
You have a good command of SQL and experience with at least one BI or data-visualisation tool.
You are able to translate business questions into clear data requirements, metrics, and analyses.
You understand Finance concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash, costs, and unit economics.
You have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to audit and structure existing models.
You are professionally fluent in English, both written and spoken.
You have excellent documentation and communication skills, and are able to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.
You are curious about how the business works, rigorous about data quality, and comfortable making definitions and assumptions explicit.
You are able to work autonomously, prioritise pragmatically, and bring structure to an evolving environment.

Nice-to-have

You have experience in a B2B SaaS, software, or scale-up environment.
You are familiar with SaaS revenue metrics such as MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
You are familiar with SaaS cost metrics, including Storage, Compute, and Retention hosting costs, AI costs, and gross margin.
You have experience working with accounting, billing, HRIS, payroll, CRM, spend-management, or planning tools.
You understand data warehouses, data modelling, ETL concepts, APIs, or data-quality frameworks.
You have experience with Python or another language used for analysis and automation.
You have been exposed to HR or payroll data and understand its confidentiality requirements.

👀 Are you interested in this job but feel you haven't ticked all the boxes? Don't hesitate to apply, and tell us in the cover letter section why we absolutely must meet!

Recruitment Process

📝 Here's what's in store for you if you apply :

HR Interview with Clémentine, Talent Acquisition Manager (30')
N+1 Interview with Elie, Head of Finance (60’)
Use case to prepare at home
Restitution of the use case with a Data team member (30’)
N+2 Interview with Thérèse, CFO (60’)

Our process usually takes about 3 weeks, depending on availability; it includes reference calls.

The program: discussions rather than trick questions ! These discussions will help you understand how Sekoia works and what it stands for. But they are also (and above all) an opportunity for you to tell us about your career path and your expectations for your next job!

⭐ Sekoia is an equal opportunity employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Additional Information

Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Rennes
Possible full remote

In this role, you will help run strategic operations programs across our food production facilities, supporting cross-functional initiatives from concept through delivery. jobs.title: Customer Reference Program Manager
jobs.description:
US Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About The Role

We are seeking an AI-fluent Customer Reference Program Manager to build and run Bonterra’s AI-first customer reference program within Commercial AI. You will own live reference requests, Champion HQ, and Peerbound, helping sellers advance active opportunities, especially New Logo / New Sale deals, through relevant customer conversations, contextualized one-pagers, and case studies.

You will shape how Bonterra combines customer insight, commercial judgment, and AI to deliver the right proof at the right moment in a sales cycle. This means designing repeatable processes and using AI agents and automation to triage requests, surface relevant matches, draft proof packages, and reduce manual work, with human oversight of customer relationships, consent, and approvals. You will also help shape the program’s 2027 operating model, evaluating where Champion HQ, Peerbound, and internally built capabilities deliver the greatest seller impact and return.

Reporting into Commercial AI, this is a hands-on individual contributor role with program ownership and no direct reports. You own the reference layer; broader advocacy remains with Customer Advocacy. Success means timely fulfillment, relevant matches, seller adoption, and measurable contribution to deal outcomes, while protecting customer relationships.

What You’ll Do

Own live deal support. Manage reference requests from intake and qualification through matching, customer outreach, scheduling, briefing, and follow-up. Maintain coverage through the transition, clarify the buyer’s question and deal deadline, and close the loop with sellers on what helped the opportunity progress.
Build a repeatable operating process. Define request types, priorities, required information, service-level agreements, escalation paths, and ownership. Establish a baseline for demand and fulfillment effort, document the workflow, and remove recurring bottlenecks before automating it.
Make matching relevant to social good. Match on nonprofit mission and NTEE code/category, segment, products in use, competitor displaced, AI and technology stack (including Built With data), buyer persona, and geography. Identify coverage gaps with Sales and Customer Success, and qualify reference customers against real deal needs.
Run Champion HQ. Maintain the roster, profiles, matching rules, request workflow, and Salesforce-connected ROI reporting; resolve automation and data gaps with the appropriate system owners. Validate the agreed reporting population: Opportunity Type = New Logo and Opportunity Subtype = New Sale.
Turn Peerbound insights into deal-ready proof. Mine available customer voice sources to surface relevant evidence and potential references. Maintain source traceability, approvals, and freshness, and deliver approved proof where sellers can find and use it.
Own the AI-first reference workflow. Design, test, and run AI-assisted triage, matching shortlists, first-draft assets, and proof assembly, partnering with Commercial AI to turn repeatable processes into reliable workflows. Define source requirements, review checkpoints, exception handling, and quality checks, then measure time saved, rework, and seller impact to continuously improve performance.
Protect customer trust. Personally manage customer asks and coordinate with relationship owners on consent, availability, and participation limits. Track usage and fatigue, respect restrictions on quotes and logos, and keep customer commitments and legal approvals under human control.
Connect operations to commercial outcomes. Track fill rate, time-to-fulfill, seller utilization and adoption, reference utilization and fatigue, and influenced pipeline and ARR. Partner with RevOps to assess win-rate and sales-cycle differences on referenced deals as volume permits, distinguishing observed influence from proven lift.
Recommend the right stack and 2027 operating model. Evaluate Champion HQ and Peerbound using actual usage, seller impact, fulfillment effort, cost, and ROI. Recommend whether to retain, reshape, replace, or bring capabilities in-house, accounting for contract timing, integration and maintenance effort, migration risk, and the level of support each segment needs.
Build adoption with your partners. Work with Sales, Customer Advocacy, Customer Success, Product Marketing, RevOps, Legal, and Commercial AI to maintain clear handoffs and a shared view of reference readiness. Enable sellers on the request path and reusable proof, and use their feedback to improve coverage and fulfillment.

Who You Are

4+ years of relevant B2B SaaS experience in customer references, advocacy operations, sales enablement, or commercial programs, including direct ownership of reference requests supporting active sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience operating a reference platform such as Champion HQ or ReferenceEdge and a customer-proof platform such as Peerbound or a close equivalent, including profiles, workflows, permissions, and seller delivery.
Fluent in Salesforce opportunity fields, report filters, and data validation, with the ability to connect reference activity to opportunities and recognize gaps in reporting.
A proven process builder who has turned an inconsistent request workflow into clear intake rules, matching criteria, service levels, documentation, and reporting.
AI-first and fluent in applying generative AI, knowledge bases, and workflow automation to day-to-day program operations. You can demonstrate workflows you have designed or improved, explain how you validate outputs, and measure quality, time saved, and business impact.
Strong customer judgment and relationship skills, including making thoughtful requests, managing expectations, and balancing sales urgency with customer readiness and consent.
Clear, concise writing skills and the ability to turn customer evidence into useful seller briefs and one-pagers without overstating results.
Able to own priorities independently, work through incomplete data and evolving processes, and bring cross-functional partners with you as the program changes.

Bonus Points For

Direct administration of Champion HQ and hands-on use of Peerbound are strongly preferred.
Experience in nonprofit or social-good markets, including mission-based segmentation and NTEE taxonomies.
Experience with Gong or other call intelligence tools, content repositories, and review-site content as sources of customer proof.
Experience building reference ROI reporting or evaluating software vendors against an in-house operating model.
Experience connecting AI workflows to CRM, call intelligence, or content systems through no-code tools or integration requirements.

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. Take the lead on complex, high-impact technical programs that drive innovation, scalability, and operational excellence across a diverse portfolio of client projects. In this senior role, you will connect business strategy with technical execution, coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, product, design, and project management. You will serve as a trusted partner to clients and executive stakeholders, translating complex technical challenges into clear plans and measurable outcomes. By managing dependencies, risks, resources, and competing priorities, you will help teams deliver high-quality results predictably. You will work in a collaborative, fast-paced, fully remote environment that values autonomy, sound judgment, and continuous improvement. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced program leader who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys influencing decisions across teams and organizations.

Accountabilities

Lead complex, large-scale technical programs involving multiple development teams, products, and organizations.
Oversee the overall program portfolio, managing schedules, dependencies, risks, resource allocation, and critical blockers to ensure successful delivery.
Act as the primary point of contact for clients and executive stakeholders, setting expectations, communicating progress, and maintaining alignment on objectives and outcomes.
Partner with senior leaders to resolve challenges, evaluate technical trade-offs, and support informed, strategic decision-making.
Translate complex technical concepts into business implications, facilitating discussions and collaboration across engineering, product, design, and other functions.
Establish clear goals, ownership, and accountability across teams to maintain momentum and delivery quality.
Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen program processes, predictability, and execution.
Track progress against program objectives and promote a results-oriented approach focused on measurable business and technical impact.

Requirements

At least 8 years of experience in technical program management within software engineering or other highly technical environments.
Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional technical programs involving multiple product development teams and senior stakeholders.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, system architecture, artificial intelligence, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and modern engineering practices.
Demonstrated ability to engage with senior leaders, assess technical trade-offs, and navigate complex challenges in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, align diverse teams, and influence executive-level decisions without direct authority.

jobs.description:

Position Title:

Position Location:

Remote — work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to job sites, lab environments, and company meetings

Job Summary

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance. Our Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project — and it is the home of SmartTech.ai, our company-wide AI enablement program.

AI adoption at STC has grown fast and organically: capable people across every department have built real tools and returned real time. That grassroots energy is our foundation — and it has outgrown an informal, team-by-team approach. As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands-on support.

This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering & Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub-and-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Program Governance, Policy & Intake (20%)

Establish light-touch, practical governance for AI use company-wide — acceptable-use standards, data-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec
Contribute to development of the innovation and idea intake (“funnel”), triaging incoming requests and prototypes and prioritizing them by value, effort, and risk
Maintain a lightweight review cadence that keeps the program safe and consistent without slowing the people doing the work

AI Enablement, Training & Messaging (20%)

Raise the AI fluency of the entire company — technical and non-technical staff alike — through hands-on training, office hours, documentation, and reusable prompt and workflow libraries
Own internal messaging and change management for SmartTech.ai: announcements, wins, and adoption campaigns that build momentum and engagement
Coordinate the departmental AI Champions network, turning individual wins into shared, company-wide capability

Solution Development & Deployment (20%)

Turn ideas and prototypes into deployable, supportable solutions — designing, building, and shipping LLM-powered tools, agents, and integrations
Serve as a hands-on power user of Claude and modern AI development tools, setting the technical bar for prompt engineering, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over company knowledge, and API integration
Harden and deploy high-value prototypes built by others so delivery teams can rely on them without owning their maintenance

Development Frameworks & Hosting Platforms (15%)

Design and stand up the sanctioned development environments, hosting platforms, and DevOps toolchain (source control, CI/CD, containerization, cloud hosting) that let AI solutions be built, deployed, and maintained safely and repeatably
Replace ad-hoc, unsanctioned workarounds with secure, documented, scalable infrastructure, in coordination with IT and InfoSec
Establish reusable patterns, templates, and reference architectures for AI application development

Tool & Use-Case Portfolio Management (15%)

Evaluate, select, and manage the company's portfolio of AI tools and platforms; map tools to specific business needs and use cases so teams adopt the right tool for the job
Track adoption, value, and ROI; maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI investments aligned to corporate growth targets
Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and cost, and advise leadership on build-vs-buy decisions

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency (10%)

Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output
Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization
Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget
Performs other related duties as assigned

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Power user of Claude (claude.ai, Claude Code, CoWork, Projects, connectors/MCP, and agentic tools) with fluency across the modern AI tool landscape (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Perplexity)

Workflow automation platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio)

Description

The Bespoke Solutions Teams is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to own contractor operations, vendor management, and lab/manufacturing coordination for a high-assurance hardware program within AWS Infrastructure Services — the team building security and encryption devices for government customers.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. You will consolidate contractor hiring and management, own vendor and license agreements, and serve as the operational backbone that lets our senior engineers stay focused on delivery. You will be the connective tissue across engineering, supply chain, security, and external manufacturing partners — removing friction and reducing key-person dependencies on a fast-moving classified program.

You will own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, manage vendor and license agreements, coordinate contract manufacturing (including onboarding a new contract manufacturer), and serve as the lab owner. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Contractor & Resource Management

Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Vendor, License & Lab Ownership

Manage vendor and license agreements
Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
Serve as the lab owner

Contract Manufacturing

Own contract manufacturing for the program, including onboarding a new contract manufacturer
Handle associated administrative tasks including purchasing coordination.
Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to keep prototype and production builds on schedule

Cross-Organization Coordination

Partner with engineering, systems engineering, security, and leadership to keep operational execution tight
Serve as primary operational liaison for contractor, vendor, and manufacturing matters
Provide program status, risk, and resourcing visibility to engineering leads and program leadership

A day in the life

You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. The team executes against a multi-year roadmap spanning hardware, firmware, programmable logic, and systems engineering — with a growing contractor base and expanding manufacturing footprint. This Program Manager role is the operational anchor that keeps contractor, vendor, and manufacturing execution running smoothly as the program scales from prototype into production.

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

You will be the connective tissue across engineering, supply chain, security, and external manufacturing partners — removing friction and reducing key-person dependencies on a fast-moving classified program.

You will own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, manage vendor and license agreements, coordinate contract manufacturing (including onboarding a new contract manufacturer), and serve as the lab owner. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Contractor & Resource Management

Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Vendor, License & Lab Ownership

Manage vendor and license agreements
Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
Serve as the lab owner

Contract Manufacturing

Own contract manufacturing for the program, including onboarding a new contract manufacturer
Handle associated administrative tasks including purchasing coordination.
Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to keep prototype and production builds on schedule

Cross-Organization Coordination

Partner with engineering, systems engineering, security, and leadership to keep operational execution tight
Serve as primary operational liaison for contractor, vendor, and manufacturing matters
Provide program status, risk, and resourcing visibility to engineering leads and program leadership

A day in the life

You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. The team executes against a multi-year roadmap spanning hardware, firmware, programmable logic, and systems engineering — with a growing contractor base and expanding manufacturing footprint. This Program Manager role is the operational anchor that keeps contractor, vendor, and manufacturing execution running smoothly as the program scales from prototype into production.

About The Team

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
