Descripción del cargo

En este rol serás el gestor estratégico de proyectos de Blend en México, liderando iniciativas tecnológicas complejas desde su inicio hasta su cierre. No se trata solo de coordinar tareas: serás el pensador estratégico que mantiene múltiples workstreams alineados, identifica riesgos antes de que se conviertan en crisis, y es la cara confiable de Blend ante nuestros clientes clave. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con AWS, navegarás metodologías diversas según lo que el cliente requiera, y serás un mentor para recursos junior. Tu autonomía será alta, pero siempre dentro de un marco de excelencia y visión big picture.

🎯 Responsabilidades clave

Gestionar proyectos end-to-end con mínima guía
, manteniendo alcance, tiempo, costo, riesgos y calidad bajo control, independientemente de si lidera 1 o 7 proyectos simultáneamente.
Dominar múltiples metodologías
(Scrum, Cascada, CI/CD, metodologías de olas) según las necesidades del cliente, demostrando flexibilidad y criterio estratégico para elegir la mejor aproximación.
Analizar causa raíz de incidentes y diseñar planes de mitigación
que mantengan la confianza del cliente y protejan el negocio de Blend.
Ser el punto de relación estratégica con clientes clave y AWS
, participando en conversaciones de alto nivel, eventos y relacionamiento que fortalezcan la partnership.
Mentorizar y liderar recursos junior
(otros PMs en desarrollo), contribuyendo a la construcción de talento interno y al desarrollo de capabilities de la organización.
Desarrollar conocimiento transversal
de tecnología, data, diseño, marketing y otras capabilities de Blend, convirtiéndote en referente (thought leader) que conecta soluciones creativas con necesidades del cliente.

🧠 Requerimientos

Experiencia y habilidades (Requeridas/Indispensables)

5+ años de experiencia demostrada en Project Management
, liderando proyectos complejos de tecnología en ciclos de venta y entrega de 6+ meses, con evidencia clara de cierre on-time y satisfacción de cliente.
Fluidez en inglés técnico (B2 sólido mínimo)

, demostrando adaptabilidad para elegir y aplicar la metodología correcta según contexto del proyecto.
Maestría en análisis de causa raíz y gestión de riesgos
, identificando problemas potenciales tempranamente y diseñando estrategias de mitigación que protejan el proyecto.
Experiencia gestionando simultáneamente múltiples proyectos/workstreams
, priorizando de forma estratégica sin perder visibilidad en ninguno.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Fire Suppression
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Fire Suppression Project Manager is responsible for delivering fire protection scope on assigned projects from award through final acceptance and closeout. Working within the general contractor's overall schedule, the Project Manager coordinates design, submittals, permits, material lead times, field manpower, progress tracking, change management, and communication with the general contractor. Work must comply with applicable NFPA standards, project specifications, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Review the awarded subcontract scope, drawings, and specifications to define and communicate the deliverables included in our scope of work; identify scope gaps, exclusions, and out-of-scope work early and route them to management.
Manage the design and submittal process - coordinate sprinkler shop drawings, hydraulic calculations, stock listings, and product data with the NICET-certified designer, and submit through the general contractor to the engineer of record and AHJ.
Obtain fire protection permits and approvals; schedule and support rough-in, hydrostatic, trip, flow, and final acceptance testing with the fire marshal and inspecting authorities.
Forecast the labor, material, and equipment required to complete the project and communicate manpower needs to the field superintendent and foremen.
Track material and equipment lead times - particularly long-lead items such as fire pumps, backflow assemblies, and specialty valves - and provide the purchasing agent with the quantities, dates, and delivery sequence needed to keep the installation on schedule.
Track project costs and installed labor hours against the awarded estimate, and report variances and cost impacts to management.
Plan and manage our installation schedule within the general contractor's overall project schedule; attend coordination and progress meetings and keep our work sequenced with the other trades.
Coordinate with the NICET-certified designer during layout and coordination to resolve conflicts with ductwork, piping, structure, and ceiling systems before fabrication.
Identify, price, and submit change order requests for added or altered scope; track approval status and ensure no out-of-scope work proceeds without written authorization.
Issue progress updates to management and the general contractor regarding schedule, manpower, material status, and open items.
Ensure all work is installed in compliance with the applicable NFPA standards, project specifications, and state and local fire and building codes.
Manage project closeout - punch list completion, as-built drawings, owner training, and turnover of O&M manuals and inspection, testing, and maintenance documentation.
Address employee issues and concerns in accordance with company policies and procedures

Requirements

Working knowledge of fire suppression systems in commercial construction - wet, dry, pre-action, deluge, standpipe, and fire pump systems - and of the applicable NFPA standards (13, 13R, 13D, 14, 20, 24, and 25).
At least 2 years of project management experience, preferably with a specialty trade subcontractor.
Comfortable reading and understanding architectural, structural, and MEP blueprints, sprinkler shop drawings, and hydraulic calculations.
Familiarity with the AHJ permitting and inspection process and with acceptance testing requirements.
Able to read and understand subcontract scope, exclusions, and general conditions well enough to manage our obligations and recognize when work falls outside them.
Ability to schedule, sequence, and forecast field labor, and to track costs against an established estimate.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build working relationships with general contractor project managers and superintendents.
Strong leadership, management, and decision-making skills.
Proficient in working with Microsoft Office; comfortable learning the company's project management and construction management software.
Contributes to and supports a positive, respectful, and collaborative team culture through professionalism, teamwork, open communication, and constructive interactions with colleagues.

Dental insurance
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
Vision insurance

By day 90

Drive lasting impact:

You’ll work alongside implementation managers, engineers, product managers, customer success partners, and clinical experts

Use deployment insights to inform internal product and process improvements, helping the organization deliver more effectively at scale

required BA/BS degree

Description

Are you excited by the idea of building financial systems that power global trade? As Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT) expands its global reach and technology product portfolio, it needs billing infrastructure that can keep pace with onboarding new customers across markets. We are looking for a Program Manager to own end-to-end financial automation and compliance program delivery across our customs finance operations. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Tax, Accounting, Compliance, and Engineering, translating upstream product decisions into correctly configured, operationally ready financial systems that enable accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) payment flows with vendors, ports of entry, and government entities worldwide.

You will manage a cross-functional program independently, own all program communication, and drive timely decisions across partner teams. The configuration work you deliver is the on/off switch for Amazon's ability to bill, collect revenue, make vendor payments, and meet financial obligations to government and legal entities. A misconfigured charge code means invoices do not generate, disbursements do not clear, and government fees go unremitted. If you thrive in high-stakes, detail-oriented environments where your work has immediate and measurable financial impact, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Lead the financial readiness lifecycle from intake through post-launch stabilization, ensuring no incomplete or non-compliant work reaches engineering and coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate system behavior before launch.
Drive AP and AR automation execution across multiple regions in partnership with Accounting, Tax, and billing engine teams, and set up performance indicators where none exist.
Manage onboarding of new trading partners and broker billing model migrations, including net-new legal entity standup, working with Finance, Compliance, and Engineering stakeholders to meet regulatory and financial obligations.
Own the charge code, company code, and Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) configuration pipeline across ACT finance systems by sequencing intake, managing prioritization, and driving requests to completion.
Build and improve program mechanisms that scale, including intake systems, SLA frameworks, handoff protocols, and measurement infrastructure to increase delivery predictability and reduce manual work.

A day in the life

You join recurring syncs with Engineering, Finance, Tax, and Accounting teams to align on open work-streams and unblock dependencies. You typically check of the configuration pipeline, triaging new intake requests and re-prioritizing based on urgency. Much of your work is proactive and roadmap-driven: you plan configuration sequences, prepare financial readiness gates for upcoming launches, and build playbooks that keep delivery on track. You also carve out heads-down time to refine intake mechanisms, analyze root causes of post-launch defects, and document process improvements. Along the way, you collaborate closely with fellow program managers to share context and coordinate across parallel efforts.

About The Team

Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT) is a team of program and product managers building the customs brokerage and financial infrastructure that powers Amazon's cross-border trade operations. Our mission is to make it easy for customers to meet the regulatory requirements of international goods movement while delivering value through transparent and predictable services. As ACT expands its global footprint, you will gain deep expertise in how financial automation is applied to cross-border trade, growing your skills at the convergence of finance, compliance, and technology. We are a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving, and we are excited to welcome someone who wants to help shape the future of global trade at Amazon.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

The Bespoke Solutions Teams is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to own contractor operations, vendor management, and lab/manufacturing coordination for a high-assurance hardware program within AWS Infrastructure Services — the team building security and encryption devices for government customers.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Contractor & Resource Management

Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
Serve as the lab owner

You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. Als Project Manager – AI & Data Transformatie coördineer en optimaliseer je de implementatie, verdere uitrol en opschaling van AI/GenAI-modellen en datagedreven oplossingen binnen de Compliance- en aanverwante business transformatieprojecten van Belfius (met als huidige kernfocus KYC, AML, S&E). Coördinatie & Governance
Beheer een geïntegreerde AI/GenAI-roadmap voor compliance- en business transformatieprojecten, afgestemd op de strategische doelstellingen van Belfius en de wettelijke vereisten.
Betrek en stem actief af met data science teams, IT, compliance en externe partners om draagvlak, betrokkenheid en ethische AI-adoptie te waarborgen.

Coördineer afhankelijkheden en synergieën tussen AI/GenAI-initiatieven, complianceprojecten (KYC, AML) en businessprocessen om duplicatie te vermijden en de efficiëntie te maximaliseren.

Werk nauw samen met Compliance business teams om vereisten te vertalen naar AI-oplossingen (bv. automatiseren van KYC-controles, verbeteren van witwasdetectie, ... ).
Creëer dashboards/notulen om de impact van AI op businessresultaten te volgen (bv. minder fout-positieven, ...).
Stel verbeteringen voor aan AI-workflows, tools en samenwerkingsmodellen op basis van prestatiegegevens.

ACTI combines technical expertise, strategic analysis, and advanced tooling to identify emerging threats, track adversary activities, and provide actionable intelligence across Amazon's security ecosystem.

As a Senior Intelligence Analyst within ACTI, you will architect and lead the creation of professional finished intelligence products that leverage ACTI's unique technical insights as well as other sources. You will utilize your extensive cyber threat intelligence knowledge to extract novel insights, trends, and themes from the output of ACTI technical processes and engineers. You will present your findings across a broad array of internal stakeholders, including Amazon Security executives and the leadership of ACTI and other security teams. Your technical and written leadership will drive ACTI's products and reporting program forward as you develop new product lines, find better ways to get actionable intelligence to internal customers, and gather customer feedback to inform future reporting.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities

Conduct in-depth research and analysis of potential cyber threats to Amazon, AWS, subsidiaries, and their customers
Collect, manipulate, and analyze data from multiple sources and assess this information to identify security threats and develop recommendations and reporting accordingly
Prepare written reports and presentations based on your research, collection, and analysis of intelligence data
Prepare and present oral and written reports on the conclusions and recommendations drawn from your research
Lead and participate in collaborative working groups and other initiatives

A day in the life

As a Senior Intelligence Analyst on ACTI, your day might start by reviewing overnight threat actor activity flagged by our automated triage systems, then pivoting into drafting a finished intelligence assessment on an emerging campaign targeting AWS customers. Mid-morning you collaborate with partner intelligence teams on products. After lunch you collaborate with engineers to refine an AI-powered analytical workflow, then spend the afternoon developing a new product line based on customer feedback. You close the day by mentoring other analysts on analytic tradecraft and reviewing their draft report before publication. No two days look the same, but every day produces intelligence that protects millions of customers.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

The CRB Graduate Development Program (GDP) is a non-rotational 17-month program that provides the opportunity to develop a broad knowledge base, varied skills, and diverse network. R&A Enterprise Risk Consulting Overview

Colleagues working in Risk & Analytics’ Enterprise Risk Consulting (ERC) team provide our clients with a smarter way to analyze risk, using quantification, structured approaches, risk analytics tools and subject matter expertise to improve client outcomes. With our expertise and tailored solutions, we improve complex enterprise risk management by identifying, quantifying and mitigating unpredictable, interconnected risks.

We currently work with some of the world’s largest and complex organizations to assess and manage their strategic risks. We also work with smaller organizations early in their ERM journeys. , efficace

avec une approche qui brise les silos
, qu'ils soient technologiques, organisationnels ou culturels.

Job Description

Sekoia
is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence. Following a €26M Series B in 2025, we are scaling the company and preparing for the next stages of our development.

As Finance Data Analyst
, you will turn fragmented financial and corporate data into reliable information for decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Finance
and working closely with Data Engineering
, you will act as the bridge between Finance and technical teams.

You will map data sources
, clarify definitions, investigate discrepancies, and structure the datasets and reporting needed for financial and corporate steering. You will work hands-on with the available data without owning the data lake or every integration end-to-end. Your role will be to challenge data quality and assumptions
, document what is missing, and help Finance and leadership rely on consistent and actionable information.

In this evolving environment, you will bring structure while keeping a practical focus on delivering useful analysis, reporting, and automation.

Systems In Scope

Your scope will cover data from the main systems used for financial, commercial, operational, and corporate steering:

Data: Metabase (you will be the owner of the tool)
Finance and planning: Pennylane, Agicap, Pigment (you will be the owner of the data in the tool), and Excel
Revenue and CRM: HubSpot and Younium
People and expenses: Lucca, SILAE, Navan, and TeamTailor (ATS - recruitment tool)
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Azure, and OVH billing data

You will work with Data Engineering and the relevant system owners to connect, transform, document, reconcile, and improve the accessibility of this data.

Your Missions

Map and structure Finance data
Map the systems, data sources, owners, definitions, and flows used for financial and corporate steering.
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplications, and reconciliation issues between sources.
Define the data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.
Clarify the definitions and calculation rules for key metrics such as revenue, ARR, NRR, headcount, payroll cost, COGS, cash, and spend.
Maintain a prioritised backlog of data needs and improvement opportunities with Finance and Data Engineering.
Turn data into reliable analysis
Explore and model data from the data lake and connected business systems.
Build consistent, documented, and reusable Finance and corporate datasets.
Reconcile data across accounting, billing, RevOps, HR, payroll, cash management, and spend-management systems.
Produce recurring analyses and reporting to support Finance and leadership decision-making.
Build dashboards and self-service views when the underlying data is sufficiently reliable.
Support budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS metrics analysis.
Improve data quality and automate reporting
Work with Data Engineering and system owners to complete missing data sources, transformations, and quality checks.
Automate recurring analyses, reconciliations, and reporting where this creates clear value.
Contribute to data quality monitoring, documentation, and governance for Finance-related data.
Document data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, and known limitations.
Prepare reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI use cases.
Handle HR, payroll, and other sensitive data with a high level of confidentiality and rigour.

You will work closely with the Head of Finance
, Data Engineering
, the RevOps Manager
, the FinOps Manager
, and other data owners across the company to align definitions, clarify responsibilities, and make Finance data more reliable and accessible.

📍 The position is ideally based in Paris, but can also be based in Rennes, or fully remote from Europe. Professional trips paid for by the company might be required.

Your Profile

🤩 We are excited to meet you if :

You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, Finance analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related role.
You have strong analytical skills and are able to investigate data across several systems to identify the reasons behind discrepancies.
You have a good command of SQL and experience with at least one BI or data-visualisation tool.
You are able to translate business questions into clear data requirements, metrics, and analyses.
You understand Finance concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash, costs, and unit economics.
You have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to audit and structure existing models.
You are professionally fluent in English, both written and spoken.
You have excellent documentation and communication skills, and are able to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.
You are curious about how the business works, rigorous about data quality, and comfortable making definitions and assumptions explicit.
You are able to work autonomously, prioritise pragmatically, and bring structure to an evolving environment.

Nice-to-have

You have experience in a B2B SaaS, software, or scale-up environment.
You are familiar with SaaS revenue metrics such as MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
You are familiar with SaaS cost metrics, including Storage, Compute, and Retention hosting costs, AI costs, and gross margin.
You have experience working with accounting, billing, HRIS, payroll, CRM, spend-management, or planning tools.
You understand data warehouses, data modelling, ETL concepts, APIs, or data-quality frameworks.
You have experience with Python or another language used for analysis and automation.
You have been exposed to HR or payroll data and understand its confidentiality requirements.

👀 Are you interested in this job but feel you haven't ticked all the boxes? Don't hesitate to apply, and tell us in the cover letter section why we absolutely must meet!

Recruitment Process

📝 Here's what's in store for you if you apply :

HR Interview with Clémentine, Talent Acquisition Manager (30')
N+1 Interview with Elie, Head of Finance (60’)
Use case to prepare at home

The program: discussions rather than trick questions ! These discussions will help you understand how Sekoia works and what it stands for. But they are also (and above all) an opportunity for you to tell us about your career path and your expectations for your next job!

⭐ Sekoia is an equal opportunity employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

new_jobs.description:
US Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About The Role

We are seeking an AI-fluent Customer Reference Program Manager to build and run Bonterra’s AI-first customer reference program within Commercial AI. You will own live reference requests, Champion HQ, and Peerbound, helping sellers advance active opportunities, especially New Logo / New Sale deals, through relevant customer conversations, contextualized one-pagers, and case studies.

You will shape how Bonterra combines customer insight, commercial judgment, and AI to deliver the right proof at the right moment in a sales cycle. This means designing repeatable processes and using AI agents and automation to triage requests, surface relevant matches, draft proof packages, and reduce manual work, with human oversight of customer relationships, consent, and approvals. You will also help shape the program’s 2027 operating model, evaluating where Champion HQ, Peerbound, and internally built capabilities deliver the greatest seller impact and return.

Reporting into Commercial AI, this is a hands-on individual contributor role with program ownership and no direct reports. You own the reference layer; broader advocacy remains with Customer Advocacy. Success means timely fulfillment, relevant matches, seller adoption, and measurable contribution to deal outcomes, while protecting customer relationships.

What You’ll Do

Own live deal support. Manage reference requests from intake and qualification through matching, customer outreach, scheduling, briefing, and follow-up. Maintain coverage through the transition, clarify the buyer’s question and deal deadline, and close the loop with sellers on what helped the opportunity progress.
Build a repeatable operating process. Define request types, priorities, required information, service-level agreements, escalation paths, and ownership. Establish a baseline for demand and fulfillment effort, document the workflow, and remove recurring bottlenecks before automating it.
Make matching relevant to social good. Match on nonprofit mission and NTEE code/category, segment, products in use, competitor displaced, AI and technology stack (including Built With data), buyer persona, and geography. Identify coverage gaps with Sales and Customer Success, and qualify reference customers against real deal needs.
Run Champion HQ. Maintain the roster, profiles, matching rules, request workflow, and Salesforce-connected ROI reporting; resolve automation and data gaps with the appropriate system owners. Validate the agreed reporting population: Opportunity Type = New Logo and Opportunity Subtype = New Sale.
Turn Peerbound insights into deal-ready proof. Mine available customer voice sources to surface relevant evidence and potential references. Maintain source traceability, approvals, and freshness, and deliver approved proof where sellers can find and use it.
Own the AI-first reference workflow. Design, test, and run AI-assisted triage, matching shortlists, first-draft assets, and proof assembly, partnering with Commercial AI to turn repeatable processes into reliable workflows. Define source requirements, review checkpoints, exception handling, and quality checks, then measure time saved, rework, and seller impact to continuously improve performance.
Protect customer trust. Personally manage customer asks and coordinate with relationship owners on consent, availability, and participation limits. Track usage and fatigue, respect restrictions on quotes and logos, and keep customer commitments and legal approvals under human control.
Connect operations to commercial outcomes. Track fill rate, time-to-fulfill, seller utilization and adoption, reference utilization and fatigue, and influenced pipeline and ARR. Partner with RevOps to assess win-rate and sales-cycle differences on referenced deals as volume permits, distinguishing observed influence from proven lift.
Recommend the right stack and 2027 operating model. Evaluate Champion HQ and Peerbound using actual usage, seller impact, fulfillment effort, cost, and ROI. Recommend whether to retain, reshape, replace, or bring capabilities in-house, accounting for contract timing, integration and maintenance effort, migration risk, and the level of support each segment needs.
Build adoption with your partners. Work with Sales, Customer Advocacy, Customer Success, Product Marketing, RevOps, Legal, and Commercial AI to maintain clear handoffs and a shared view of reference readiness. Enable sellers on the request path and reusable proof, and use their feedback to improve coverage and fulfillment.

Who You Are

4+ years of relevant B2B SaaS experience in customer references, advocacy operations, sales enablement, or commercial programs, including direct ownership of reference requests supporting active sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience operating a reference platform such as Champion HQ or ReferenceEdge and a customer-proof platform such as Peerbound or a close equivalent, including profiles, workflows, permissions, and seller delivery.
Fluent in Salesforce opportunity fields, report filters, and data validation, with the ability to connect reference activity to opportunities and recognize gaps in reporting.
A proven process builder who has turned an inconsistent request workflow into clear intake rules, matching criteria, service levels, documentation, and reporting.
AI-first and fluent in applying generative AI, knowledge bases, and workflow automation to day-to-day program operations. You can demonstrate workflows you have designed or improved, explain how you validate outputs, and measure quality, time saved, and business impact.
Strong customer judgment and relationship skills, including making thoughtful requests, managing expectations, and balancing sales urgency with customer readiness and consent.
Clear, concise writing skills and the ability to turn customer evidence into useful seller briefs and one-pagers without overstating results.
Able to own priorities independently, work through incomplete data and evolving processes, and bring cross-functional partners with you as the program changes.

Bonus Points For

Direct administration of Champion HQ and hands-on use of Peerbound are strongly preferred.
Experience in nonprofit or social-good markets, including mission-based segmentation and NTEE taxonomies.

new_jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

AI Program Manager — Special Projects and Innovation

Position Location:

Remote — work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to job sites, lab environments, and company meetings

Job Summary

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance. Our Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project — and it is the home of SmartTech.ai, our company-wide AI enablement program.

AI adoption at STC has grown fast and organically: capable people across every department have built real tools and returned real time. That grassroots energy is our foundation — and it has outgrown an informal, team-by-team approach. As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands-on support.

This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering & Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub-and-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Program Governance, Policy & Intake (20%)

Establish light-touch, practical governance for AI use company-wide — acceptable-use standards, data-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec
Contribute to development of the innovation and idea intake (“funnel”), triaging incoming requests and prototypes and prioritizing them by value, effort, and risk
Maintain a lightweight review cadence that keeps the program safe and consistent without slowing the people doing the work

AI Enablement, Training & Messaging (20%)

Raise the AI fluency of the entire company — technical and non-technical staff alike — through hands-on training, office hours, documentation, and reusable prompt and workflow libraries
Own internal messaging and change management for SmartTech.ai: announcements, wins, and adoption campaigns that build momentum and engagement
Coordinate the departmental AI Champions network, turning individual wins into shared, company-wide capability

Solution Development & Deployment (20%)

Turn ideas and prototypes into deployable, supportable solutions — designing, building, and shipping LLM-powered tools, agents, and integrations
Serve as a hands-on power user of Claude and modern AI development tools, setting the technical bar for prompt engineering, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over company knowledge, and API integration
Harden and deploy high-value prototypes built by others so delivery teams can rely on them without owning their maintenance

Development Frameworks & Hosting Platforms (15%)

Design and stand up the sanctioned development environments, hosting platforms, and DevOps toolchain (source control, CI/CD, containerization, cloud hosting) that let AI solutions be built, deployed, and maintained safely and repeatably
Replace ad-hoc, unsanctioned workarounds with secure, documented, scalable infrastructure, in coordination with IT and InfoSec
Establish reusable patterns, templates, and reference architectures for AI application development

Tool & Use-Case Portfolio Management (15%)

Evaluate, select, and manage the company's portfolio of AI tools and platforms; map tools to specific business needs and use cases so teams adopt the right tool for the job
Track adoption, value, and ROI; maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI investments aligned to corporate growth targets
Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and cost, and advise leadership on build-vs-buy decisions

new_jobs.description:
Description

The Bespoke Solutions Teams is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to own contractor operations, vendor management, and lab/manufacturing coordination for a high-assurance hardware program within AWS Infrastructure Services — the team building security and encryption devices for government customers.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. You will consolidate contractor hiring and management, own vendor and license agreements, and serve as the operational backbone that lets our senior engineers stay focused on delivery. You will be the connective tissue across engineering, supply chain, security, and external manufacturing partners — removing friction and reducing key-person dependencies on a fast-moving classified program.

You will own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, manage vendor and license agreements, coordinate contract manufacturing (including onboarding a new contract manufacturer), and serve as the lab owner. Your success is measured by smooth operational execution, reduced administrative load on engineering leads, and reliable delivery of contractor and manufacturing support as the program scales toward production.

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2)

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Contractor & Resource Management

Consolidate contractor hiring and management responsibilities.
Own the end-to-end contractor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, performance tracking, and off-boarding
Reduce key-person dependencies by establishing repeatable contractor management processes

Vendor, License & Lab Ownership

Manage vendor and license agreements
Take ownership of the unclassified lab and similar work-streams
Serve as the lab owner

Contract Manufacturing

Own contract manufacturing for the program, including onboarding a new contract manufacturer
Handle associated administrative tasks including purchasing coordination.
Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to keep prototype and production builds on schedule

Cross-Organization Coordination

Partner with engineering, systems engineering, security, and leadership to keep operational execution tight
Serve as primary operational liaison for contractor, vendor, and manufacturing matters
Provide program status, risk, and resourcing visibility to engineering leads and program leadership

A day in the life

You will join a team within AWS Infrastructure Services that designs, develops, and delivers high-assurance security and encryption hardware for highly regulated government use cases. The team executes against a multi-year roadmap spanning hardware, firmware, programmable logic, and systems engineering — with a growing contractor base and expanding manufacturing footprint. This Program Manager role is the operational anchor that keeps contractor, vendor, and manufacturing execution running smoothly as the program scales from prototype into production.

About The Team

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
7+ years of program or project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience managing contractors, vendors, and/or external manufacturing partners
Experience managing vendor and license agreements and purchasing/procurement coordination
Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, or Master's degree
Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
Experience in a hardware, FPGA, or manufacturing program environment
Experience onboarding and managing contract manufacturers (CM/NPI)
Experience owning lab operations and badge/facility access ownership
Current, active US Government Security clearance of TS / SCI with Polygraph

in the United States to lead cross-functional operational strategy, scale internal systems, and manage critical programs across provider operations.

The Senior Manager, Provider Operations Strategy & Programs
will lead cross-functional operational strategy, scale internal systems, and manage critical programs across provider operations, partnering with senior leadership and pillar leaders while managing and mentoring project managers.

Responsibilities

Partner with senior leadership to define and prioritize quarterly initiatives spanning multiple pillars or requiring cross-functional coordination, developing comprehensive program briefs that define scope, stakeholders, timelines, resource requirements, success metrics, and dependencies.
Drive strategic programs from initiation through close-out, monitoring milestone progress, escalating blockers early, and measuring quantitative outcomes (such as fill rate impact, cost savings, and cycle time) alongside qualitative outcomes (such as process improvements and cross-team alignment).
Collaborate with pillar leaders to document core operational workflows and design scalable systems, tooling, playbooks, checklists, SLAs, and decision trees that support business growth without requiring proportional headcount increases.
Audit workflows for operational gaps, redundancies, and hand-off friction, recommending actionable improvements and overseeing implementation.
Serve as a central connector across Quality of Service, Staffing, Experience, Growth, Analytics, and Strategy & Programs pillars, identifying cross-functional signals, conflicts, and strategic opportunities early.
Manage operational relationships between Provider Operations and cross-functional teams in Sales, Product, and Support, proactively setting expectations around capacity and constraints.
Lead quarterly planning sessions with pillar leaders to align on strategic roadmaps and identify potential risks and dependencies.
Maintain an eight-week forward-looking view to anticipate market shifts, business developments, and product changes that impact provider strategy.
Manage and mentor project managers, expanding their scope of ownership and guiding them into managing increasingly complex initiatives.
Evaluate automation and AI tools in partnership with pillar leaders to assess operational and economic value versus unnecessary complexity.

Qualifications

6+ years of experience in operations, business operations, or program management, or equivalent leadership impact in a relevant domain.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional work and influencing decisions without positional authority, including successfully leading 3+ concurrent programs across multiple teams.
Proven track record of managing and mentoring one or more direct reports into independent operators.
Demonstrated success building or significantly improving repeatable, standardized operational processes that scale effectively with business growth.
Professional experience operating within a high-growth company environment.
Strong data fluency, including the ability to self-serve data to identify operational problems, track key performance indicators, and guide trade-off decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to present complex trade-offs and strategic recommendations to senior leadership clearly and without jargon.
High comfort with ambiguity and a track record of effective decision-making in environments with incomplete information.
Strong execution orientation, with demonstrated ability to establish realistic plans, monitor progress, course-correct proactively, and consistently deliver results.

Required Skills

Experience in operations, business operations, or program management.
Ability to manage cross-functional work and influence decisions without positional authority.
People management and mentoring skills.
Process design and improvement skills for scalable operations.
Experience in high-growth company environments.
Data fluency and ability to self-serve data.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to make decisions in ambiguous environments with incomplete information.
Strong execution and project delivery skills.

Preferred Skills

Professional experience in supply-side operations, provider or marketplace operations, or recruiting and staffing supply chains.
Experience working in regulated industries or environments with complex external stakeholder management, such as the gig economy, healthcare staffing, or field services.
Hands-on experience evaluating, piloting, and implementing new operational tools or automation technologies.
Workshop design and facilitation skills, including experience leading strategic planning sessions or cross-team retrospectives.

Position Description & Qualifications

Looking for a Program Manager
opportunity at a place you can make a difference every day? Discover this opportunity at our Washington D.C.
location!

As the Program Manager, you will lead a dynamic team that provides Scientific, Engineering, Technical, and Analytical (SETA) support for US Navy’s Shipyards and Naval Industrial Base efforts and contribute directly to maintaining a high level of fleet readiness. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact towards our military defense and safety of our sailors.

This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your current DoD Secret level clearance.

The Program Manager will support the US Navy’s Shipyards and Naval Industrial Base efforts related workforce/workload management, logistic services, business operations, and total force initiatives in support of shipyard Corporate Project Execution, support, and workforce training. The Program Manager will provide the technical scope and associated tasks for support of NAVSEA’s LEAN Process/Performance Improvement initiatives, Project Management Fundamentals, Integrated Project Team Development, Industrial Operations support, Coaching and Development for Deck-plate Project Team Performance, Environmental, Safety and Health program support, and miscellaneous support to headquarters regarding industrial operations and management.

In This Role, You Will

Lead a large, dedicated team of Serco professionals providing administrative, financial, logistical, and management support to the Government’s execution of training and project support programs.
Engaging with NAVSEA and Naval Shipyard Subject Matter Experts regarding the specific support required to achieve tasking requirements within each Government activity.
Direct your team in the delivery of all required contract deliverables.
Direct your team in hosting and coordination of quarterly and other Ad Hoc program reviews.
Provide program infrastructure assistance; process administration; organization and technical implementation; and the governance necessary to evolve process/performance improvement.
Conduct financial and cost management through continual cost control and review.
Develop budgets and manage technical performance within budgetary constraints.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have

An active or current DoD Secret clearance and ability to maintain it (Will consider Interim Secret Clearance)
US Citizenship
A Bachelor's degree in business, Management, Engineering, or similar field
Or an Associate's Degree and minimum 9 years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of BA degree
Or a High School Diploma/GED and minimum 11 years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of degree

Minimum 7 years of relevant experience (Experience in business management, process improvement, human performance, adult learning/instruction, and financial management experience highly preferred)
Minimum 5 years of contract management experience
Experience with workforce management, organizational effectiveness, and performance
Knowledge of the Department of WAR PPBE process
Must be willing to travel 10% of the time outside the DC area as required
Washington Navy Shipyard (WNY)
Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, Maine (PNSY)
Norfolk Naval Shipyard, Portsmouth Virginia (NNSY)
Puget Sound Naval Shipyard, Bremerton Washington (PSNS)
Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard, Hawaii (PHNSY)

new_jobs.title: Software Implementation Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
About 3E

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About The Role

As an Implementation Project Manager at 3E, you’ll lead larger, more complex customer implementations where successful delivery requires multiple products, technical contributors, workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders to operate against one coordinated plan.

You’ll be accountable for turning the customer’s scope of work into an executable implementation strategy and for determining whether the overall project succeeds—on time, within scope, adopted, and connected to a clear customer outcome. You’ll establish success and acceptance criteria, own the integrated project plan, manage risk and change, coordinate specialists and technical teams, and give both customers and 3E leadership a clear, data-backed view of project health.

You’ll understand the technical delivery deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify dependencies, connect customer needs with the right specialists, and engage credibly with Product and Engineering. You won’t need to personally execute every configuration, migration, or integration; your role is to ensure those pieces come together into a successful customer outcome.

This position supports remote work within the Eastern time zone.

What You’ll Do

Lead complex new-logo, cross-sell, and Value Realization implementations from internal handoff through customer acceptance and formal close.
Translate complex scopes of work into an integrated delivery strategy covering products, workstreams, milestones, resources, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
Lead technical discovery and pre-integration planning with customers, CX technical specialists, and relevant internal teams.
Own the master implementation plan and coordinate implementation specialists, Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical consultants, external partners, and customer resources.
Establish measurable success and acceptance criteria at kickoff and maintain accountability for those outcomes throughout delivery.
Lead customer project governance, including senior stakeholder and sponsor communications.
Maintain the milestone tracker and conduct phase-gate reviews, giving a clear assessment of whether projects are on track, at risk, or behind and establishing mitigation plans when required.
Identify cross-workstream dependencies and risks early and determine their impact on the critical path.
Lead complex, multi-product delivery by managing scope and change control, coordinating custom development through launch, maintaining a unified customer plan across teams, and providing leadership with clear, data-backed reporting on project health, risk, timelines, value, and adoption.
Build and maintain dashboards or reporting tools that make project status and risks visible without relying solely on status meetings.
Lead customer escalations diplomatically while maintaining accountability for customer commitments, decisions, resources, data readiness, and signoffs.
Partner with Commercial on implementation handoff and identify expansion opportunities or renewal risks surfaced during delivery.
Represent the delivery perspective during pre-sales scoping of complex or higher-risk opportunities so commitments can be successfully delivered.
Drive structured post-onboarding Value Realization Projects, including complex migrations, integrations, optimization, remediation, and workflow initiatives.
Manage multiple concurrent implementations and make prioritization decisions based on risk, complexity, dependencies, and customer impact.
Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, delivery predictability, time-to-value, and the overall customer experience.

Required

What Makes You a Great Fit

3–5 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services.
Demonstrated experience leading complex customer implementations with multiple workstreams, technical dependencies, contributors, or products.
Experience owning project scope, plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, change control, customer communication, and delivery outcomes.
Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand configuration, data, integration, and technical delivery sufficiently to coordinate specialists and identify risk; coding is not required.
Demonstrated ability to lead customer conversations and communicate credibly with senior customer stakeholders.
Ability to lead and influence cross-functional contributors without formal authority.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and making informed prioritization decisions based on customer and business impact.
Strong written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot and Microsoft Office, with comfort using data, dashboards, and systems of record to communicate project health.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and changing scope while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
Willingness to travel 10–20%.

Preferred

Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience with enterprise and/or mid-market SaaS customers.
Experience developing or improving implementation processes and customer journeys.
Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk.
Experience working with time-to-value, adoption, usage, or customer health metrics.
Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software.
Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting global customers.

This role must be based in one of the states where 3E is authorized to hire, and eligible to work without sponsorship.

Our US Benefits Include

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance and disability coverage
Open PTO and parental leave
401(k) plan with company matching
Employee assistance program
Voluntary supplemental benefits (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness)

Description

Leidos Security Operations is seeking an experienced and mission-driven Executive Protection Program Manager to lead protective operations for our executive leadership team within a high-security, high-compliance defense industry environment. This role will ensure the safety, security, and operational continuity of executives during domestic and international travel, corporate events, and site visits.

The Executive Protection Manager will work closely with threat intelligence, corporate security, cybersecurity, and compliance teams to ensure that protective measures meet operational needs.

The job is based at Leidos Global Headquarters in Reston, Virginia.

Primary Responsibilities

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, the selectee will be responsible for:

Lead and manage executive protection operations for the CEO, executive leadership team, and Board of Director members in alignment with corporate security protocols and U.S. government regulations.
Recruiting, training, and leading a three-person team comprised of two protection professionals and one executive driver ensuring training, readiness, and operational discipline.
Conduct threat, vulnerability, and risk assessments for all executive-attended events, movements, external meetings, and site visits to ensure their safety.
Engaging and collaborating cross-functionally on event and travel schedules and planning to ensure robust protection of key stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with security analysts, Global Resilience security, and government security agencies to ensure accurate situational awareness.
Coordinating, budgeting, and managing contracted external services and assessments in support of the Executive Protection Program.
Planning, and executing the Program’s operational budget.
Assessing, documenting, implementing and enforcing use of force practices, armed protection requirements, and training curriculum as well as proposing changes to policies, procedures, and playbooks related to the Program.
Integrate cybersecurity and physical security considerations into all executive protection planning.
Ensuring all protection operations comply with company policies and legal requirements while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and discretion.
Provide executive leadership with discreet situational intelligence briefings on relevant geopolitical, terrorism, and criminal threats.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelors degree and 8+ years of executive protection, preferably with corporate security experience, with 3+ years in a leadership or management role. Additional years experience may be used in lieu of a degree.
Experience supporting executives or high-value assets in sensitive environments.
Completion of a recognized executive protection training course
Strong working knowledge of threat assessment, advance planning, emergency medical response, and protective operations in compliance-heavy industries.
Proven ability to coordinate with U.S. government security agencies (DSS, FBI, DHS, etc.) and understand relevant security clearance protocols.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief senior executives and collaborate at all levels.
Current CPR and AED medical certifications.
Valid driver’s license with clean driving record; defensive/evasive driving training.
Willingness to travel (including OCONUS) and work some non-standard hours based on executive requirements.
Must meet all Virginia Department of Criminal Justice Services Personal Protection Specialist requirements with the ability to successfully achieve certifications in armed and unarmed personal protection specialist as well as basic and advanced handgun
Proven ability to maintain composure in dealing with authorities, executives, clients, staff, and the public, including under conditions of urgency and in high-pressure situations
Must be physically fit to provide protective coverage during physically taxing activities
Knowledge of unarmed self-defense tactics (use of force)
Must be a US citizen with ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance
Possess superior critical thinking skills, analytic ability, creativity, keen attention to detail, and problem-solving skills to address unanticipated issues
Proven ability as a self-starter who can work independently and as part of a team to deliver high value customer support

Preferred Qualifications

Current Top Secret security clearance
Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, or related field
Experience at the senior organizational level leading dynamic teams
Experience integrating protective intelligence, cyber threat data, and physical security operations
Active Paramedic, First Responder, and Emergency Medical Technician certifications
Experience operating security camera systems/CCTV, access control, and alarm systems
Experience responding to workplace violence issues
De-escalation training
Possess a valid Virginia concealed handgun permit or be eligible to carry under the Law Enforcement Officer Safety Act or HR218
Technical Surveillance Counter Measures experience
Open-source intelligence training or experience

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Securing Your Data

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to deliver end-to-end technical program execution across hardware, software, optics and manufacturing - setting the structure, aligning teams, and driving critical programs from R&D through to on-time mass manufactured product delivery.

As Technical Program Manager, you will run a number of programs critical to OLIX’s delivery. You’ll partner closely with engineering to set direction, identify blockers, implement risk mitigations and report on status. You’ll take ownership of cross-functional delivery within your programs, ensuring reliable, high-quality execution in areas critical to OLIX's roadmap.

Own end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs from initiation through to completion.

Identify, track, and mitigate risks and blockers before they impact delivery.
Manage vendor and partner relationships through scope changes, timeline conflicts, and commercial negotiations

Continuously improve delivery processes, tooling, and ways of working across the program.

Broad engineering background with some technical experience across hardware, software and manufacturing.

Who We Are

We are Tennis! The USTA (United States Tennis Association) is the national governing body for the sport of tennis and the leader in promoting and developing the sport’s growth on every level in the United States, from local communities to the crown jewel of the professional game, the US Open.

The USTA Foundation Incorporated (USTAF or USTA Foundation) is the social impact arm of the United States Tennis Association Incorporated (USTA), utilizing the powerful combination of tennis and education to enhance the lives of under-resourced youth through its support of the National Junior Tennis & Learning (NJTL) network. For more than 50 years, NJTL has impacted thousands of under-resourced youth across the nation, and today the network features more than 270 chapters that reach more than 233,000,000 young people from under-resourced communities annually.

Why Work for the USTA?

We are a passionate team of staff and volunteers focused on growing the sport of tennis and making it accessible to all. We are committed to removing barriers and creating opportunities for ALL to participate.

About Lulu's Place

Lulu's Place will offer state-of-the-art facilities in Los Angeles, north of LAX airport, between the communities of Westchester and Playa del Rey, bringing together academic, athletic, and wellness programs for youth from all backgrounds. Trusted partners, including TGR Foundation, a Tiger Woods charity; the United States Tennis Association (USTA) and its charitable arm, USTA Foundation; Cedars-Sinai; and Providence will bring together professional teachers, coaches, mentors, and service providers to deliver high-quality programs to children and their families.

The vision for this project is rooted in the passion and generosity of Carol "Lulu" Kimmelman, a Southern California native, former elementary school teacher in South Los Angeles, and lifelong tennis player who passed away in 2017 after a courageous battle with ovarian cancer. Today, her husband, Doug Kimmelman, and their four children honor Lulu's legacy by advancing her mission to transform young people's lives and create greater equity in sports and education through this groundbreaking youth center.

The Role

The Program Manager will support the youth development program focused on college and career readiness and non-degree career pathways, working within a shared facility alongside several partner organizations. This role is responsible for day-to-day program execution and direct oversight of program staff. Includes partner integration and collaboration on programmatic delivery.

Day-to-Day Program Execution

Operational Oversight: Manage day-to-day operations for USTAF Center for Innovation programming, ensuring all activities align with the foundation’s mission, goals, priorities, and safety standards.
Partner and Site Integration: Coordinate with the program staff of Lulu's Place, TGR Foundation, and other on-site program partners to execute educational and tennis programming and achieve shared goals.
Coordinate day-to-day use of shared space, equipment, and resources with co-located partner organizations
Serve as the on-site liaison for partner organizations on operational and scheduling matters (e.g., room bookings, shared equipment, daily logistics)
Escalate any partner matters involving cost, liability, space allocation disputes, or agreement terms to the Executive Director rather than resolving them directly

Quality Assurance: Responsible for the oversight and delivery of USTAF programs and partnered programs to accomplish established and shared goals.
Ensure program sessions, workshops, and events run on time and as planned, including opening/closing logistics.
Ensure program spaces are set up, maintained, and left in appropriate condition after use.
Troubleshoot and resolve day-to-day operational issues (scheduling conflicts, space usage, materials, technology, attendance) as they arise

Record Keeping: Maintain daily and weekly program logs, attendance records, and activity documentation
Collect and maintain accurate data on student enrollment, attendance, participation, and outcomes for core programming, following data definitions and quality standards set by the Executive Director and Lulu's Place leadership.
Prepare regular reports on program activities and metrics for the Program Director and Lulu's Place Leadership
Support grant reporting by compiling relevant program data and documentation
Maintain organized records and files related to program operations

Asset Inventory: Monitor and maintain inventory of program materials and supplies, placing orders or requests as needed
Safety: Ensure day-to-day compliance with youth safety policies, including check-in/check-out procedures and supervision ratios
Compliance: Support the Program Director in implementing organizational policies and procedures at the staff level
Strategic direction: Identify opportunities to test and expand programs/products to increase the reach and enhance the impact of NJTL sports-based interventions within the community.

Staff Supervision & Support

Directly supervise a team of full-time and part-time program staff, mentors, and coordinators for core high school and middle school programming
Provide administrative supervision of the Outreach Coordinator (scheduling, timesheets, day-to-day check-ins); the Outreach Coordinator's programmatic priorities and calendar are set jointly by the Executive Director and Outreach Coordinator and should be respected as protected, not reassigned to cover core programming needs
Create and manage staff schedules, ensuring adequate coverage across all program activities and age groups
Provide day-to-day coaching, guidance, and support to staff on curriculum delivery and student engagement
Conduct regular check-ins and team meetings with program staff
Onboard and train new staff and volunteers on program procedures, policies, and expectations
Monitor staff performance and provide feedback; escalate performance concerns to the Program Director, who holds final hiring and termination authority
Approve staff timesheets and time-off requests in accordance with organizational policy

Curriculum & Activity Coordination

Coordinate the delivery of college and career readiness curriculum, workshops, and mentorship sessions for high school and middle school students
Coordinate with the Outreach Coordinator to align core programming with elementary/middle school outreach efforts where relevant, without absorbing outreach staffing or scheduling into core program operations
Work with staff to adapt lesson plans and activities to meet the needs of different age groups and skill levels
Coordinate guest speakers, site visits, employer partners, and other enrichment activities
Track and ensure completion of program milestones and deliverables tied to funder or grant requirements

Student & Family Communication

Serve as the primary daily point of contact for student and family questions, concerns, and updates related to core programming
Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding schedules, events, and student progress
Monitor student participation and follow up on attendance issues or disengagement
Address day-to-day behavioral or logistical issues, escalating more serious concerns to the Program Director

Who You Are

Education: A bachelor’s degree in a related field such as Sports Management, Recreation Administration, Education, Social Work, or Non-Profit Management is required.
Work Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in program coordination, youth development, or sports administration. Tennis background and/or understanding of the tennis environment is required.
Partner Management: Proven track record of managing relationships with community partners, schools, or diverse local organizations is required.
Safety Certifications: Valid CPR, First Aid, and AED certifications (or the ability to obtain them within 30 days of hire) are required.
Clearance: Ability to pass comprehensive, recurring federal and state background checks to work with minors is required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) and Google Workspace is required. Experience using CRMs or program management software is preferred.
Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for travel between facility sites is required.
Schedule Flexibility: Ability to work non-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends, to align with youth sports schedules is required.
Physical Stamina: Ability to be mobile and active on sports courts or fields for extended periods and lift/move equipment up to 50 lbs is required.

What We Offer

At the USTA, we know people are our most important asset. For this reason, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet the needs of a diverse workforce!

Flexibility: Our Hybrid with Flexibility approach combines a balance of remote working with in-office collaboration to spark teamwork and creativity.

Come One, Come All

We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested; we'd love to learn how you can “serve” our team with your unique experience!
